name: edrUnclassifiedDeviceCount
definition: The number of devices in the endpoint inventory that requiredCoveragePercentage divides by and that the transform can classify as neither a server nor a workstation.
population: devices in neither class (for example mobile devices, storage or Kubernetes nodes, or a missing type). The denominator and the protected test are exactly the ones the same transform uses for requiredCoveragePercentage, so the split agrees with the blended figure.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the device inventory. Null when the read is partial or failed.

changeLog.change: Registered with the EDR server / workstation coverage split added to four EDR coverage transforms under edr* names (additive; no requirement reads it yet).

notes: Supporting count for the server / workstation coverage split; not a criterion on its own today.
